user.title: Siemens OZW672
user.description:
Enter the address and credentials of your OZW672.
If you need HTTP rather than HTTPS, enable it on the device first under Home > 0.x OZW672.xx > Settings > Communication > Services.
Setup instructions are linked from the integration's documentation.

device.title: Siemens OZW672 - Device Selection
device.description: Only devices with 'State: Generated' will be displayed here

data.use_device_longname: Use the Device Addr+Device as the Name
data.prefix_with_function: Prefix entities with Function? (eg "RVS43.345/109->DHW - Legionella function")
data.prefix_with_opline: Prefix entities with Operating Line Number? (eg "1640 Legionella function")

mainmenu.title: Siemens OZW672 - Main Menu
mainmenu.description: Please chose the Menu Item(s) you wish to discover

data.menuitems: Select one or more Menu Items
data.go_back: ◀ Go back to the previous step (discards what is selected here)

submenu.title: Siemens OZW672 - Menu: {item_name}
submenu.description:
Select what to monitor under {item_name}. Each datapoint is shown with the value the device reports right now — one with no value costs a request on every poll and stays permanently unknown.

Tick a datapoint in the list for the polling rate it needs. Each datapoint belongs in exactly one.

data.datapoints_medium: Poll at a medium rate — priority 2
data.select_all: Look inside every submenu listed above
data.select_rest_slow: Also take everything else on this screen at priority 3
data.go_back: ◀ Go back to the previous step (discards what is selected here)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the OZW672. Check the hostname/IP and that the device is reachable.
error.no_previous_step: This is the first step of the setup, there is nothing to go back to.
error.duplicate_priority: A datapoint is ticked in more than one priority. Each one belongs in exactly one — see the log for which.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The existing OZW672 device was updated with your new selection.
abort.no_menu_items: No menu items were selected, so there is nothing to configure.

menu_options.settings: Connection, polling intervals and entity domains
menu_options.priorities: Which datapoints are polled how often

data.use_device_longname: Use the Device Addr+Type instead of the DeviceName
data.verify_ssl: Verify the HTTPS certificate (leave off for the device's self-signed certificate)

priorities.title: Siemens OZW672 - Polling priorities
priorities.description: Sort the {count} configured datapoints into polling tiers. Anything you do not pick is polled in the slowest tier.

datapoints.title: Siemens OZW672 - Configured datapoints
datapoints.description:
{count} datapoints are configured. Untick one to stop polling it.

Disabling an entity in Home Assistant does not stop its datapoint being polled — removing it here does. The entity stays in the registry as unavailable and can be deleted there.

To add datapoints, run the integration's setup again for the same device.
